## Recorded progress and lifecycle entries

The recorded status labels include both “Current” and “Lapsed”. These labels describe what the available records say; they do not establish a Bill’s final fate. In particular, reading “Current” as proof of continued progress or enactment, or “Lapsed” as a certified final outcome, could misstate what happened where dated entries point in another direction. The dated entries establish the recorded developments, but do not explain or resolve those differing signals. [a-f9ba2a6f948bae191bdb]
_Provisional interpretation — moderate qualitative confidence (provisional)_

For Protection of Private Residences (Against Targeted Picketing) Bill 2021, the records include Committee Stage on 23 May 2024 and Report Stage and Fifth Stage entries dated 4 July 2024. They also include a Bill Lapsed Event and a Second Stage entry dated 8 November 2024, followed by another Second Stage entry dated 1 May 2025, alongside a Current status label. These are recorded developments; their coexistence does not settle the Bill’s final outcome or explain the differing signals. [a-a25c2c312690548c8721]
_Provisional interpretation — moderate qualitative confidence (provisional)_

Differing signals also appear in other records. Horticultural Peat (Temporary Measures) Bill 2021 has a Current status label, a Bill Lapsed Event dated 29 January 2025 and a Second Stage entry dated 27 March 2025. Health (Postponement of Certain Leave) Bill 2024 has a Current label and a Bill Lapsed Event dated 29 January 2025, together with Second Stage entries dated 29 January and 27 March 2025. Later stage entries include Second Stage for Road Traffic (Amendment) (Jax’s Law) Bill 2026 on 16 September 2026, Public Health (Tobacco) (Amendment) (Smokefree Generation) Bill 2026 on 22 September 2026, and Artificial Intelligence Companion Services (Protection of Children) Bill 2026 on 29 September 2026. These entries document activity, not the Bills’ final outcomes. [a-382ae6fbb8b4dc582ac2]
_Provisional interpretation — moderate qualitative confidence (provisional)_

## Overview

The retrieved sponsorship results identify 20 distinct Bills. The lifecycle records document progress through a range of stages, and include both “Current” and “Lapsed” status labels as well as Bill Lapsed Event entries. For some Bills, those signals appear together with later stage entries; they should be reported separately rather than treated as a settled final disposition. The search for final outcomes did not establish what ultimately happened to the Bills. That does not show that no parliamentary records of outcomes exist. The available selection is not certified exhaustive, and its freshness is unknown. [a-bf821596de635f398bb1]
_Provisional interpretation — moderate qualitative confidence (provisional)_
